newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zeroual sets constitutional referendum for Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: Zeroual sets constitutional referendum for Nov 28.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual announced on Monday that a referendum to change the constitution to ban political parties based on religion, and confirm Islam as Algeria's state religion, would be held on November 28.
He made the statement in a speech broadcast on state-run Algerian television.

Zeroual's 30-minute address, a rare nationwide broadcast by the former general, followed a week's upsurge of violence in the North African country in which at least 60 people were killed and more than 70 wounded.
"Once again and through your vote in the referendum on November 28 you are called to underline our national future," Zeroual said.
"Your answer is your choice in the search to develop a multi-party democracy with unity and with stability."
